instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for RoomRelay Turnover Board: The board coordinates room-reset work between event sessions and confirms readiness before the next session. The Event Coordinator creates a turnover task for a named room. The Session Host records whether the room is ready and adds a reason when it is not ready. The coordinator may close the task only after the host records the room as ready.

output.summary: RoomRelay Turnover Board coordinates room-reset work between event sessions and confirms readiness before the next session. The Event Coordinator creates a turnover task for a named room, and the Session Host records readiness with a reason for a not-ready result. The coordinator may close the task only after the host records the room as ready.
output.primary_goal: Coordinate room-reset work between event sessions and confirm readiness before the next session.
key_capabilities: Create a turnover task for a named room.
Record whether the room is ready.
Add a reason when the room is not ready.
Close the task only after the room is recorded as ready.

instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Overview: RoomRelay Turnover Board is used between sessions to coordinate room-reset work and confirm readiness before the next session. The Event Coordinator creates the task and names the room. The Venue Crew Lead assigns it and records required setup items, while a Venue Crew Member marks each item complete after the reset. The Session Host records readiness, gives a reason for a not-ready result, and the coordinator closes the task only after a ready result. Catering orders are outside this project.

output.summary: RoomRelay Turnover Board coordinates room-reset work between sessions and confirms readiness before the next session. The Event Coordinator creates a task for a named room, the Venue Crew Lead assigns it and records setup items, and a Venue Crew Member marks those items complete after the reset. The Session Host records readiness and a reason for a not-ready result, and the coordinator closes the task only after a ready result. Catering orders are outside the project.
output.primary_goal: Coordinate room-reset work between sessions and confirm readiness before the next session.
key_capabilities: Create a turnover task and name the room.
Assign the task and record required setup items.
Mark setup items complete after the room reset.
Record room readiness and a reason for a not-ready result.
Close the task only after a ready result.
